let distance p1 p2 =
    let dx = p1.x -. p2.x in
    let dy = p1.y -. p2.y in
    sqrt (dx *. dx +. dy *. dy)

let map_points f pts =
    map f pts

let color_to_string = function
    | Red   -> "red"
    | Green -> "green"
    | Blue  -> "blue"

let () =
    let p1 = { x = 0.0; y = 0.0 } in
    let p2 = { x = 3.0; y = 4.0 } in
    printf "Distance: %f\n" (distance p1 p2)
